```yaml
name: Continue Agents

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      agents-path:
        description: "Path to the directory containing agent markdown files"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ".continue/agents"

jobs:
  discover-agents:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      agents: ${{ steps.set-agents.outputs.agents }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Find agent files
        id: set-agents
        run: |
          AGENTS_PATH="${{ inputs.agents-path }}"
          if [ ! -d "$AGENTS_PATH" ]; then
            echo "Directory $AGENTS_PATH does not exist."
            echo "agents=[]" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            exit 0
          fi

          # Find all .md files, get relative paths, and format as JSON array
          AGENTS_JSON=$(find "$AGENTS_PATH" -name "*.md" -type f | jq -R -s 'split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))')
          echo "agents=$AGENTS_JSON" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  run-agents:
    needs: discover-agents
    if: ${{ needs.discover-agents.outputs.agents != '[]' && needs.discover-agents.outputs.agents != '' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        agent: ${{ fromJson(needs.discover-agents.outputs.agents) }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20

      - name: Install Continue CLI
        run: npm install -g @continuedev/continue

      - name: Run Agent
        id: run-agent
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          AGENT_FILE="${{ matrix.agent }}"
          AGENT_NAME=$(basename "$AGENT_FILE" .md)
          
          echo "::group::Running Agent: $AGENT_NAME"
          
          OUTPUT_FILE="agent-output-${AGENT_NAME}.txt"
          
          # Execute the agent using the continue CLI
          # Capture output and exit code
          if command -v continue &> /dev/null; then
             # Assuming 'continue agent' is the command to run an agent file
             # If the CLI command differs, adjust accordingly.
             continue agent "$AGENT_FILE" > "$OUTPUT_FILE" 2>&1
             EXIT_CODE=$?
          else
             echo "Continue CLI not found. Please ensure it is installed."
             exit 1
          fi
          
          echo "::endgroup::"
          
          # Capture output for check run
          if [ -f "$OUTPUT_FILE" ]; then
            # Use a unique variable name per agent to avoid collisions in matrix
            # Sanitize agent name for env var key if necessary, though basename usually safe
            SAFE_NAME=$(echo "$AGENT_NAME" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            echo "AGENT_OUTPUT_${SAFE_NAME}<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            cat "$OUTPUT_FILE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "AGENT_EXIT_CODE_${SAFE_NAME}=$EXIT_CODE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            SAFE_NAME=$(echo "$AGENT_NAME" | tr -cd '[:alnum:]_-')
            echo "AGENT_OUTPUT_${SAFE_NAME}=No output generated" >> $GITHUB_ENV
            echo "AGENT_EXIT_CODE_${SAFE_NAME}=1" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Create Check Run
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const agentPath = "${{ matrix.agent }}";
            const agentName = path.basename(agentPath, '.md');
            
            // Retrieve output and exit code from environment variables
            // Note: In github-script, process.env contains the environment variables
            const safeName = agentName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '');
            const outputKey = `AGENT_OUTPUT_${safeName}`;
            const exitCodeKey = `AGENT_EXIT_CODE_${safeName}`;
            
            const output = process.env[outputKey] || "No output";
            const exitCode = parseInt(process.env[exitCodeKey] || "1", 10);
            
            const conclusion = exitCode === 0 ? 'success' : 'failure';
            
            await github.rest.checks.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              name: `Continue Agent: ${agentPath}`,
              head_sha: context.sha,
              status: 'completed',
              conclusion: conclusion,
              output: {
                title: `Agent Result: ${agentPath}`,
                summary: output.substring(0, 65535), // GitHub limit
                text: output
              }
            });

      - name: Write Job Summary
        run: |
          AGENT_NAME=$(basename "${{ matrix.agent }}" .md)
          echo "## Agent: $AGENT_NAME" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo "" >> $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
          echo '
```
